about: What tmux said for terminal-live-scroll.spec.ts, recorded from a real tmux by hand, never by a test.

Each moment comes after its input pasted into the pane: what the viewing client was sent meanwhile (stream), what tmux said of the pane then (pane: its history from -S -5000 -E -1, the normal screen a program on its alternate screen left from -a -q, the first two rows from -S 0 -E 1, and the pane format ViewHistory reads), what the client was sent after refresh-client (repaint), and what a client attaching then was sent (attach).
